title: Supermodularity and Submodularity in Network Interdiction
summary: We study a bilevel network interdiction problem, with an attacker interdicting (attacking) certain components of a network and a defender optimizing operations over the ensuing network. We study when the defender's optimal objective is submodular or supermodular with respect to the attacker's interdiction decisions, for optimizing the bilevel integer program more efficiently.
